The FBI, Secret Service, and IRS-CI have officially linked the October 29 theft of $6.3 billion from Binance to North Korea’s APT group TraderTraitor.

Authorities released a list of more than 600 wallets and called on exchanges, node operators, and DeFi platforms to block them.

The hack triggered heavy outflows from Binance: $3.64 billion in net withdrawals during the first 9.5 hours after withdrawals reopened, rising to $4.7 billion by Monday morning.

Scammers are already taking advantage of users’ fears.
